contents.text: Listen and read along with the passage about animal parents and their babies.

paragraphs.text: Many animal parents do things over and over to help their babies. For example, like most birds, robin parents feed their baby chicks many times every day.

Baby animals also do things over and over to get food and stay safe. For example, robin chicks cry every time they are hungry. This lets their parents know to bring food. Eating food helps the chicks live and grow.
